DTR · TALK ABOUT A SCENE

Forty a Day, Then Double

STS-HS11-L4-1400P-HSALG2-ARA-API-02 • HS Math Algebra II Grade 11 • Comparing Two Functions in Different Representations
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
Every summer from the 1920s, thousands of Filipino workers called Alaskeros sailed north to the salmon canneries and came home in the fall with a season of pay and a season of numbers. Some families kept those numbers in a ledger, written down day by day. Others painted them as a curve on canvas so you could see a whole season in one look. The same season can be a table of numbers or a shape on a grid, and each one shows you something the other hides.
One record adds the same amount every day and the other doubles, so which one wins, and does it win right away?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
